summary: Frontend-only verification of Belote tutorial coach bubble fixes. Fixed a critical syntax corruption at the tail of /app/frontend/src/i18n.tsx (duplicate 'export const useI18n' + orphan 'r>) );}' that was preventing the file from parsing. After fix, ran an end-to-end Playwright flow: login tester1 -> unlock tutorial_progress via localStorage -> open /tutorial -> start final pedagogical game -> observe bidding + play tricks -> then run solo-game regression. All 4 verifiable acceptance criteria pass; contre-warning bubble did not occur in this random deal (acceptable per request).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — coming from RN 0.79 web deprecation; app-wide, non-blocking but should be migrated. Reference: theme/shadow helper (grep 'shadow(' in /app/frontend/src/theme).
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — appears throughout the app. Non-blocking. Migrate `pointerEvents="none"` JSX props to style.pointerEvents.

Console warning: '[Reanimated] Couldn\'t load entering/exiting animation. Current version supports only predefined animations with modifiers: duration, delay, easing, randomizeDelay, withCallback, reducedMotion.' — appears during hand play, likely on a custom FadeIn/FadeOut. Not blocking but should be reviewed for web compatibility.
Expo doctor warning in expo logs: react-native-keyboard-controller@1.18.6 installed, expected 1.18.5. Consider aligning.

test_report_links: Inline Playwright scripts run against https://card-table-orient.preview.emergentagent.com; screenshots at /tmp/tutorial_post_bid.png, /tmp/solo_final.png
action_items: Optional: migrate deprecated RN web props (shadow* → boxShadow, pointerEvents JSX prop → style.pointerEvents) to silence console noise.
Optional: align react-native-keyboard-controller to 1.18.5 to match Expo SDK expected version.

The 90 / 110 / 130 opponent bid variants and the contre coach-warning were not observed in this random deal — they can only be validated deterministically via unit-test level fixtures. Backend already covers heuristics with 104/104 pytest; frontend interpolation for {need}/{needBelote}/{value}/{suit} is verified via the other bubbles that rendered without placeholder leaks.
critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL FIX APPLIED: /app/frontend/src/i18n.tsx had a duplicated 'export const useI18n = () => useContext(LanguageContext);' followed by orphan JSX ('r> );}') at lines 866–871 that would have broken the whole Metro bundle. Removed the trailing garbage. Please double-check any recent edit to this file to avoid a regression.

Minor: /app/frontend/app/game/[id].tsx line 182 uses `Math.min(ev.value ?? 90, 130)` to pick coach_opp_bid_{value}. If a bot ever bids 80 (rare in this game), key 'coach_opp_bid_80' is undefined and i18n will fall back to the raw key. Consider clamping the low end too (e.g. Math.max(90, Math.min(v, 130))).
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/i18n.tsx (removed duplicated export + orphan JSX at EOF)
